purpose: Preserve how model capability and cost change over time under the same BuilderOS governance so the system can distinguish model improvement from governance improvement.
rules: Never overwrite an old model/version result with a newer version.

Every benchmark receipt records provider, exact model/version, task class, capability class, governance version, blueprint version, context packet version, outcome, cost, quota source, and SENTRY result.
Free, subscription-interactive, and paid/API runs are distinct economic modes even when the underlying model family is similar.
Compare new models against historical tasks when practical to measure capability depreciation and governance leverage.
Public benchmark/reputation data remains a prior; LifeOS controlled receipts determine internal routing authority.
